Welcome to Acme Cloud

Acme Cloud is a local-first automation platform for Apple Silicon. This guide walks you through your first session.

What you'll build

You'll create a headless browser session, navigate to a page, and extract its interactive structure as semantic Markdown — the input a downstream model uses to decide the next action.

Prerequisites

macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. The engine ships as a single binary with no external runtime dependencies.

Ready to build?

Start your first automation in minutes.
